prompts.text: A colossal long-necked sauropod dinosaur gives deep booming whale-like moans that echo, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A colossal long-necked sauropod dinosaur lets out a thunderous alarmed bellow, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A colossal long-necked sauropod dinosaur bellows deeply in pain, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A colossal long-necked sauropod dinosaur gives a long fading dying cry, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A colossal long-necked sauropod dinosaur: a colossal tail sweeps and slams the ground with a booming crash, four separate attacks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Enormous slow earth-shaking footsteps, deep booms far apart, well spaced and distinct. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
